name: Cera
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: one of the wives of Nemed

text: Cera, also Ceara, is an Irish name meaning red or possibly bright red. Lebor Gabála Érenn, the pseudo-history of Ireland that mixes legend with scripture, counts her among the wives of the invader Nemed. Tradition holds that she gave her name to Mag Cera, the plain of Carra in Co Mayo. The name also belongs to the Dagda and may signify creator. Scribes used it in texts and place-names. Tradition links her cult to that plain in the west of Ireland.

okr.objective: Cera is an alternate name of the Dagda and a legendary wife of Nemed who named Mag Cera.
